usefulness.rationale: The dossier clearly establishes who Anders Danielsson is (Skanska President/CEO since 2018) with identity anchors and same-name disambiguation. Concrete, cited actions: the 2018 3,000-person workforce reduction with Poland details, candid investor comments on margins, U.S. PPP strategy, and his role presenting earnings reports in 2020 and 2026. No dossier statement exceeds its cited quote; the pre-flagged unjustified conclusions (Migration Agency role, 179B SEK revenue, 2026 Best Employer award) do not appear as claims, so no overclaims are matched. Gaps: nothing beyond public earnings-call moments — no education/bio detail evidenced in citations, no explicit limitations section, and currency of the CEO role rests partly on a 2026 invitation. A reader could prepare for a business meeting on Skanska results, but not for a broader personal discussion.
